symptom: The shared workspace opens missing machine-local folders, and repository commands can resolve or configure the wrong Git checkout.
cause: Tracked workspace folders named one developer's environment, while three commands derived the repository from the caller's current directory instead of their own script location.
violatedInvariant: Tracked developer workflows anchor to the checkout that contains them and require no maintainer-specific filesystem layout.

must: Keep the shared workspace inside the cloned repository.
Resolve default repository roots from PSScriptRoot.
Run Git mutations with an explicit repository directory.

automation.residual: Optional research studies retain explicit external model and tool inputs; they are not part of the application build or daily repository workflows.
